requirementSummary: Auto-populate the Unit Type dropdown based on selected Condenser Type and Refrigerant, then auto-populate the Unit Size dropdown based on selected Refrigerant and Unit Type.
businessRules: When a user selects a Condenser Type and a Refrigerant, the Unit Type dropdown must be populated with options filtered by the selected Condenser Type and Refrigerant.
When a user selects a Unit Type, the Unit Size dropdown must be populated with options filtered by the selected Refrigerant and Unit Type.
developerConsiderations: Retrieve dropdown data via the unitdesign API endpoint GET /dropdowns.
Use the SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant attribute to obtain Unit Type options and filter on its 'parent' array containing the selected Condenser Type and Refrigerant.
Use the SDCommonUnitModelSizes attribute to obtain Unit Size options and filter on its 'parent' array containing the selected Refrigerant and Unit Type.
Implement UI logic to trigger filtering after each relevant selection change and to clear dependent dropdowns when an upstream selection changes.
Handle asynchronous API calls with appropriate loading states and error handling.
ambiguities: The ticket states filtering by Condenser Type for Unit Type, but the provided data example for SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant shows only Refrigerant in the 'parent' array; the exact mapping for Condenser Type is unclear.
The required UI behavior when a filter yields no matching Unit Type or Unit Size options is not specified.
Case sensitivity of the filtering logic is not defined.
Whether downstream selections should be reset or retained when an upstream dropdown value changes is not addressed.
